test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: When was the voting age reduced to 18 in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**In 1989**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The voting age was reduced to 18 from 21 years in the year 1989.
 
• In India, the voting age has been reduced from 21 years to 18 years by the 61st Constitutional Amendment Act of 1988.
 
• It comes into force by amending Article 326.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The bill was passed by the Lok Sabha on 15th December 1988.
 
• The bill was passed by the Rajya Sabha on 20th December 1988.
 
• The bill was assented by President Venkaraman on 28th March 1989.
 
• The bill came into force on 28th March 1989.
 
• The Prime Minister who reduced the voting age from 21 to 18 years - Rajiv Gandhi.
 
• The first general elections to the Lok Sabha were held in India - Between 25th October 1951 and 21st February 1952.
